802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.why: Cortes Acosta (17-4) aims to snap a two-fight losing skid, while Walker (23-10) will look to build off a knockout victory over Mick Parkin in October, a win that came in his Heavyweight debut at UFC 332, which you watched last month. In the co-main, #2 Tatiana Suarez faces #3 Virna Jandiroba, who fought for the vacant title last October and came up short against Mackenzie Dern; the winner likely earns a shot at champion Dern.
802b3e54-3c53-4b37-a089-8e97a4e163f3@ufc.know: A ranking from #1 to #15 shows how close a fighter is to a title shot, with the champion listed above that list. A losing or winning "skid" just means consecutive results in a row. Suarez and Jandiroba are both grapplers who win mainly by controlling opponents on the mat, a contrast to the heavyweight main event where knockouts are far more common.

89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.why: The 49ers are 6-1 and sit atop the NFC West, fresh off their bye week after their first loss of the season to Atlanta. The Raiders are 4-4, having opened 3-0 before dropping four straight. A win keeps San Francisco comfortably in first place and shows they can bounce back; a loss would make it two losses in a row, but it is still early enough that nothing is decided yet.
89e0495f-fe2d-46a6-9588-b813f1ec768e@nin.know: It is only Week 9, so no team clinches or is eliminated from the playoffs this soon; watch the division standings and win streaks instead. Running back Christian McCaffrey just returned from a mild hamstring strain (a leg muscle injury) and will carry extra workload with several receivers out hurt. Pass rusher Nick Bosa is also back healthy after missing time with a calf injury, which should boost San Francisco's defense.

17748478-21b7-4400-ae1f-363effe5688e@ufc.why: Ciryl Gane makes the first defense of his undisputed heavyweight title, facing unbeaten #4 contender Josh Hokit, a dangerous test for the champ. In the co-main, Kayla Harrison defends her bantamweight belt in her first fight back from neck surgery against Amanda Nunes, a two-division former champion ending a three-year retirement for one of the biggest matchups in women's MMA history.
17748478-21b7-4400-ae1f-363effe5688e@ufc.know: A title fight means the belt changes hands only if the champion loses; the champion keeps it in a draw or no contest. Rankings (like Hokit at #4) show how the UFC orders contenders in a division, with the champ listed separately as "C." A fighter returning from retirement, like Nunes, often faces questions about ring rust after time away from competition.
